protocol: FedBCert E17 exact finite-completion oracle audit
purpose: Measure soundness, robust-node recall, and tightness on a finite physical completion family while keeping the predictor fixed.
local_graph: four-node undirected path with retained self-loops

completion_family.endpoint_assignments: all simple local-to-remote assignments consistent with the stub counts
completion_family.remote_internal_graphs: all undirected simple graphs on the three remote nodes

remote_feature_adversary: exact independent optimization over every remote initial hidden row with L2 norm at most one

bootstrap.unit: outer seed cluster; all filter orders retained within a resampled seed
